classification.difficultyReason: Read cube side lengths and complete the scaffolded table using cubed length ratios, then state 1:n³ and apply it to supplied ratios. The fractional case requires the same taught operation without an additional strategic decision.

spec.answerVisibility: All names, shapes and side lengths are permanent givens.
